list.name: backup_time
list.query:
import "array"

saved = from(bucket: "monitoring")
  |> range(start: -3650d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "lonsemonsy_backup_schedule" and r._field == "at")
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
union(tables: [array.from(rows: [{_time: time(v: 0), _value: "1:00 AM"}]), saved])
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> tail(n: 1)
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])

options.content: Backups run every night at ${backup_time}. To change the time, run `sudo lsmsy backup time 11pm` on the server. To restore a backup, run `sudo lsmsy restore`. To add a cloud backup, run `sudo lsmsy backup setup`.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "monitoring")
  |> range(start: -30d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "lonsemonsy_backup" and exists r.store)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time,
      where: if r.store == "cloud" then "Cloud" else "Local",
      result: if r.ok == 1 then "OK" else "FAILED",
      by: if exists r.by then r.by else "",
      copies: r.copies, size: r.size, seconds: r.seconds}))
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 60)
